verdict.rationale: Sentry documents code mappings that link stack trace paths to source paths in your repository. Per the docs, these mappings enable source context, suspect commits, stack trace linking and code owners. Suspect Commits, Ownership Rules and Associate Commits are also listed as product docs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the repo-provider integration setup (e.g. GitHub/GitLab connection), documentation that stack trace links resolve to the exact line on the default branch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
